name: Bagel Sandwiches
instructions: 1. Prepare the masala by tempering mustard seeds and curry leaves in oil, then sautéing mashed potatoes with turmeric, cumin, and chopped green chilies.
2. Slice the bagels in half and lightly butter the cut sides.
3. Toast the bagel halves on a griddle until golden brown.
4. Spread a generous layer of cream cheese on the bottom half of the bagel.
5. Layer the spiced potato masala, followed by fresh cucumber, tomato slices, and onion rings.
6. Close the sandwich with the top bagel half and serve immediately with a side of spicy coconut chutney.
description: Puducherry's unique culinary landscape is a blend of French heritage and Tamil tradition. The 'Bagel Sandwich' represents this modern fusion, marrying the iconic French-style bakery items prevalent in the White Town area with the bold, earthy flavors of local Indian spiced potato fillings.
